breakdown.description: The inward hole pressure is reversed to an outward traction by changing the sign relative to the solid normal
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses 't = p * n' (positive sign) with n as the outward normal of the solid, which is the same incorrect formulation as in the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires 't = -p*n' to correctly represent inward pressure on the hole. The generated text even explicitly describes the traction as 'outward from the solid into the hole,' confirming it retained the wrong sign convention rather than fixing it to match the ground truth's inward pressure direction.
